info.name: StampMitra Developer API
info.description: Postman collection for the StampMitra Developer API (verification, e-Stamp, usage and logs, webhook events). Generated from the same OpenAPI document as https://developer.stampmitra.in/openapi.json. Set {{baseUrl}} and {{apiKey}} (your sk_test_... key) in the collection Variables.

header.description: Optional client-generated key (1 to 255 printable characters) that makes a retried POST safe. A key is scoped to your organization, the route and the environment (a sandbox key never matches a live one) and is kept for 24 hours. Retrying with the same key and the same request replays the original response (same status and body) without repeating the work or billing again. The same key with a different request returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. The same key while the first request is still being processed returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS with a Retry-After header. Routes that require the key (POST /v1/estamp/orders, POST /v1/batches) answer 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED without it.

request.description: Validates and verifies a PAN. Requires the `verification.pan.read` scope on the API key. Metered as `pan.verify` after a successful response - usage is only recorded (and the fulfilment wallet debited, for priced services) once verification completes successfully. header.description: Optional client-generated key (1 to 255 printable characters) that makes a retried POST safe. A key is scoped to your organization, the route and the environment (a sandbox key never matches a live one) and is kept for 24 hours. Retrying with the same key and the same request replays the original response (same status and body) without repeating the work or billing again. The same key with a different request returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. The same key while the first request is still being processed returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS with a Retry-After header. Routes that require the key (POST /v1/estamp/orders, POST /v1/batches) answer 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED without it.
